sections.content:
World model (revised): Roles are color-defined — white diamond = ball, gray diamond = anchor, purple square = rope. Clicking the square pulls the ball to the square and slides the square to midpoint(ball, anchor). Clicking the gray anchor swaps ball/anchor roles (colors). The ball is now overlapping the square near the anchor; level not yet complete.
Let me trace the final approach one click at a time to see what happens when the ball reaches the anchor.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']>=4 and n['color'] in ('W','G','p','M'):
            out.append((n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary']))
    return out
print('before', snap())
for k in range(2):
    # find square center (M)
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    sq=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='p' and n['pixels']>=15]
    if not sq: print('no square'); break
    b=sq[0]['boundary']
    # center approx
    rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
    cr=(min(rows)+max(rows))//2; cc=(min(cols)+max(cols))//2
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':cr,'col':cc}])
    r=last_action_result
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over') or r.get('run_complete'):
        print('STOP',k,r); break
    print('after',k, snap())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']>=4 and n['color'] in ('W','G','p','M'):
            out.append((n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary']))
    return out
print('before', snap())
for k in range(2):
    # find square center (M)
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    sq=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='p' and n['pixels']>=15]
    if not sq: print('no square'); break
    b=sq[0]['boundary']
    # center approx
    rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
    cr=(min(rows)+max(rows))//2; cc=(min(cols)+max(cols))//2
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':cr,'col':cc}])
    r=last_action_result
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over') or r.get('run_complete'):
        print('STOP',k,r); break
    print('after',k, snap())
